metadata.description: Personal agent skills, rules, subagents, commands and hooks in Hermes-style groups.

plugins.name: levistack
plugins.description: Every group: all skills, agents, commands and opt-in hooks.

plugins.name: levistack-agent-authoring
plugins.description: Creating agents, skills, rules, hooks, commands and AGENTS.md files for coding assistants.

plugins.name: levistack-architecture
plugins.description: System design and stack choices: super-architecture (detect, select, build, evaluate, migrate and document architecture), super-caching, Node backends, super-protobuf, target-stack evaluation and blueprints.

plugins.name: levistack-delivery
plugins.description: Shipping work: atomic commits, merge request descriptions, code review (local diff, request, receive, GitLab glab drafts), tickets, API collections.

plugins.name: levistack-engineering
plugins.description: Engineering habits: review, super-tdd (test-first red-green-refactor across stacks), super-refactor (multi-language behavior-preserving refactors), super-verify (evidence before claims: gate completion, verify-only, investigate first), super-noslop (domain no-slop filter for backend, API, frontend, database, config, and comments), polyglot-copywriter (plain human prose and anti-AI-tell edits), super-design (UI critique, design tokens, component libraries, DESIGN.md), clean-code principles (DRY, SOLID, YAGNI), output-savers, and Elixir with its specialities (OTP, Ecto, Phoenix, security and performance review).

plugins.name: levistack-focus
plugins.description: ADHD-friendly focus tools: shrink tasks, park tangents, keep momentum.

plugins.name: levistack-knowledge
plugins.description: Understanding code and domains: current-state codebase learning, architecture docs, site IA, grilling and challenging plans, brainstorming design, planning docs.

plugins.name: levistack-workflow
plugins.description: How a session runs: planning, brainstorming, handoffs, standups and reviews of your own work.
